title: Simon goes to New York and the Oliver band
summary: Paul Barbarin got Simon to New York with the Blue Rhythm Boys, before John; Simon later toured with the Oliver band led by Paul.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: The one who was talking to last night. Yes. He was playing with Louis Armstrong. Yeah, that's right, yeah. He was playing with Louis Armstrong. So Simon refused him and he had a little falling out. They did Simon to do a trickle. Simon wired him and next day when they went to the bank to get the tickets, Simon had his tickets and everything to go to New York.
That's how he went to New York with the Blue Rhythm Boys.
Yeah, I met with that other group. I never knew that he played up there with that group. I knew that John was up there. I never knew that Simon.
Yeah, he went even before John. Yeah.
